negative_search_evidence.interpretation: Reviewed all exact-directory matches and movement-related tool calls. No surviving Codex record shows the 48 full traces moved, uploaded or deleted after Aug19. Transfer calls mainly concern model files, source code, cubin installations and later PD logs.

evidence_chain: Recorded primary-session environment is ml-pro5000-ser171.qgz02, IP 10.207.193.139; full trace generation and archive commands ran in that session under /sgl-workspace/workspace/profile on August 19.
At August 19 03:54 UTC and 11:40 UTC the user explicitly said the machine would be reclaimed/returned and requested a Git backup.
Recorded copies to overall saved selected CSV, scripts, logs, lightweight traces, and manifests; the 32+16 original multi-rank files were deliberately omitted from the recorded Git archive.
A 127M TP0 full tar did exist temporarily in the original profile delivery tree; actual tar success, member listing and SHA are captured. No record shows its later transfer.

By August 21 the portable archive is present at /sgl-workspace/deepseek-v4-flash, at remote-matching backup commit63a288f. The archived README still says full files are outside Git on the original paths.
No later preserved tool call establishes relocation or deletion of the 48 full traces; any out-of-band movement remains possible and cannot be ruled out.
